source_note: 通过pi的无理测度证明级数收敛2
english_source_note: Proving Series Convergence via the Irrationality Measure of pi II
callout_id: 通过pi的无理测度证明级数收敛2#3
statement_en: There exist a positive real number $$c>0$$ and infinitely many positive integers $$n$$ such that $$\frac{(\frac{2}{3}+\frac{1}{3}\sin(n))^n}{n}>\frac{c}{n}.$$
callout_body: 存在一个正实数$c>0$以及无穷多个正整数$n$使得$$\frac{(\frac{2}{3}+\frac{1}{3}\sin(n))^n}{n}>\frac{c}{n}$$
